business_scope.primary_industry_name: Ownership and Cross-Border Sub-Licensing of Trademarks and Patents

applicable_bilateral_investment_treaties: ASEAN Comprehensive Investment Agreement (ACIA), in force for Viet Nam since 29 March 2012
Comprehensive and Progressive Agreement for Trans-Pacific Partnership (CPTPP), in force for Viet Nam since 14 January 2019
European Union–Viet Nam Free Trade Agreement (EVFTA), in force since 1 August 2020
Regional Comprehensive Economic Partnership (RCEP), in force for Viet Nam since 1 January 2022
Double Taxation Avoidance Agreements currently in force between Viet Nam and, inter alia, Singapore, the Republic of Korea and Japan

ubo_and_aml_profiling.statutory_law_governance: Law on Anti-Money Laundering No. 14/2022/QH15 of 15 June 2022, effective 1 March 2023; Law on Enterprises No. 59/2020/QH14 of 17 June 2020; Government Decree No. 01/2021/NĐ-CP of 4 January 2021 on enterprise registration, as amended; Government Decree No. 06/2023/NĐ-CP detailing certain measures of the Law on Anti-Money Laundering.

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Certificate of incorporation of each non-Vietnamese corporate shareholder
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Competent company registry in the shareholder’s country of origin
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Consular Legalization at a Vietnamese Embassy/Consulate abroad followed by sworn Vietnamese translation and local notarial certification (Viet Nam is not a party to the Hague Apostille Convention)

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Certificate of good standing or equivalent legal-existence certificate of each corporate shareholder
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Competent company registry or corporate affairs authority in the country of origin
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Consular Legalization at a Vietnamese Embassy/Consulate abroad followed by sworn Vietnamese translation and local notarial certification

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Notarized power of attorney authorizing the Vietnamese law agent to complete pre-incorporation and registration filings
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Notary public in the country of origin of the principal
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Consular Legalization at a Vietnamese Embassy/Consulate abroad followed by sworn Vietnamese translation and local notarial certification

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Certified identification records (passport copies) of each ultimate beneficial owner and the proposed legal representative
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Passport-issuing authority or notary public in the country of residence or nationality
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Consular Legalization or official notarial certification accepted under Vietnamese consular and notarial practice, followed by sworn Vietnamese translation

ubo_and_aml_profiling.pep_and_sanctions_screening_protocols: Mandatory screening of the legal representative, each direct and indirect shareholder, and each ultimate beneficial owner against the United Nations Security Council Consolidated List, Vietnamese domestic AML/CFT and terrorist designations, and foreign PEP databases; foreign PEPs, their family members and close associates are subject to enhanced due diligence under the Law on Anti-Money Laundering No. 14/2022/QH15 and Government Decree No. 06/2023/NĐ-CP; Vietnamese receiving banks also require OFAC SDN and EU sanctions screening for cross-border SWIFT royalty wires; all screening evidence must be documented, kept in the UBO file, and refreshed upon any trigger event.

statutory_name_clearance_protocol.registry_portal_name: National Enterprise Registration Portal (Cổng thông tin quốc gia về đăng ký doanh nghiệp) at https://dangkykinhdoanh.gov.vn
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.language_and_transliteration_doctrine: Enterprise names must be written in Vietnamese using Vietnamese script and must include the entity-type phrase 'Công ty TNHH' or 'Trách nhiệm hữu hạn' for a limited liability company; names may contain numerals, symbols, and transliterated foreign personal or trade names, but Latin-only or foreign-script names are not sufficient in themselves; the name must not be identical or confusingly similar to any name already registered in the National Enterprise Registration Database.
prohibited_and_sensitive_tokens: State agency and administrative unit names or abbreviations (e.g., 'National Assembly', 'Government', 'People's Committee') without prior ministerial approval
Armed forces, public security, and political organization designations (e.g., 'People's Army', 'People's Public Security')
Words denoting conditionally licensed activities such as 'bank', 'insurance', 'securities', 'audit', or 'fund management' without the prior approval of the relevant state regulator
Tokens violating national sovereignty, history, culture, ethics, customs, or public order
Identical or confusingly similar names of existing enterprises in the National Enterprise Registration Database
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.extension_and_rejection_appeal_sop: Viet Nam does not maintain a standalone name-reservation certificate; name protection only crystallizes upon issuance of the Enterprise Registration Certificate. If the proposed name is rejected, the applicant may (i) correct the name and file a new registration application immediately, or (ii) lodge an administrative complaint with the Director of the provincial Department of Planning and Investment within 30 days of receipt of the written rejection under the Law on Complaints No. 02/2011/QH13. If the administrative complaint is unsuccessful, judicial review is available under the Law on Administrative Procedures after administrative remedies are exhausted.

registered_office_and_commercial_substan.virtual_office_permissibility: A pure virtual or mail-forwarding address is not permissible as the sole registered office. A serviced-office address with a physical unit, a written lease agreement, and landlord confirmation is acceptable for a passive intellectual-property HoldCo; the enterprise must remain reachable and capable of receiving official notices at the registered address.
registered_office_and_commercial_substan.physical_inspection_likelihood: Low for a passive IP HoldCo: approximately 5% annual likelihood of an unannounced on-site inspection in the ordinary course; the likelihood rises to 25% or higher if the company claims tax incentives, engages in intragroup royalty arrangements with high transfer-pricing exposure, or is flagged by the tax authority or State Bank for targeted review.
